title: School hallways, anyone else?
content: Sometimes my mall world is a school. I spend a lot of time moving through the halls and stairways trying to find a classroom / person / etc depending on what the dream is that night. There's lockers lining all the hallways and usually a couple large common rooms that I don't spend much time in because they're too busy. Sometimes I am trying to avoid people who are trying to find me but it's not the same as being chased. I don't usually find what I'm looking for but I do look into many classrooms. Anyone else have this one?
